summary.zh: 策划网络研讨会，找出报名到成单各环节的流失
summary.en: Plan a webinar and find where registrations leak before conversion

description.zh: 从选题、邀请、报名页到直播出席率、回放跟进和成单转化，逐环节规划一场网络研讨会并定位漏损点。适合准备办线上活动，或报名不少但到场和转化一直上不去时使用。评分脚本需要本地 Python 环境。
description.en: Plans a webinar end to end: topic, invite, signup page, show-up, follow-up and conversion, and scores the funnel to show where it leaks. Use it before the event or when signups are high but attendance is low. Needs local Python.
